recipe.title: Supernatural Brownies
recipe.note: Preheat oven to 350°F. Butter a 13-by-9-inch pan and line with buttered parchment. Makes 15 large or 24 small brownies. Source: NYT Cooking.
recipe.ingredients:
2 sticks (16 tbsp) butter, plus more for pan and parchment
8 oz bittersweet chocolate
1 cup dark brown sugar, such as muscovado
1 cup granulated sugar
4 eggs
1/2 tsp salt
2 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup all-purpose flour (120g)
1/2 cup chopped walnuts OR 3/4 cup whole walnuts, optional

actions.text: Melt together over barely simmering water or in a microwave on low power; cool slightly
Whisk eggs, then whisk in salt and vanilla
Whisk chocolate mixture into egg mixture
If using chopped walnuts, stir in. Pour into prepared pan; if using whole walnuts, arrange on top
Bake at 350°F for 35–40 minutes, until shiny and beginning to crack on top
Cool in pan on a rack. For best flavor, bake 1 day ahead, cool and store tightly wrapped
